verdict.rationale: Chat platforms like Discord could plausibly ship an assistant that consumes MCP servers' tools, so this axis applies. The evidence pack does not mention MCP client support or any built-in AI that can use external tools. Bots, slash commands, webhooks and the REST/Gateway APIs are developer building blocks, not MCP client capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
